title: Architecting High-Throughput RAG Ingestion Engines with Delta Lake & Vector Stores
venue: International Journal of Cloud Computing & Big Data Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a hybrid retrieval framework combining sparse lexical indexing with dense vector embeddings to minimize retrieval latency and document hallucination in multi-tenant enterprise knowledge systems.

title: Cost Optimization Strategies for PySpark Workloads in Databricks Cloud Environments
abstract: Detailed empirical benchmarks evaluating Adaptive Query Execution (AQE), dynamic partition pruning, and Delta Lake Z-Ordering for large-scale financial transaction data processing.
